crossRefs.note: “The bramble said to the trees, ‘If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and take refuge in my shade; and if…
Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with…
Thus God repaid the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did to his father in killing his seventy brothers;
and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal…
They blew the three hundred trumpets, and Yahweh set every man’s sword against his fellow and against all the army; and…
When they began to sing and to praise, Yahweh set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who…
For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them.…
You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire…
You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the…
Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?
Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Beth-millo
people.line: Fortified place in Shechem, associated with Abimelech's rule.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech and devour the men of Shechem and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem and from the house of Millo and devour Abimelech.”
translations.bsb: But if not, may fire come from Abimelech and consume the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo, and may fire come from the leaders of Shechem and Beth-millo and consume Abimelech.”
translations.kjv: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
translations.asv: but if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
